study_name.notes: No formal study name provided; paper describes a cohort study of AN and controls.

target_condition.evidence_quote: Anorexia nervosa (AN) is an eating disorder

country.evidence_quote: AN patients in treatment in a specialized centre in Denmark

body_site.evidence_quote: Shotgun metagenomics and metabolomics were performed on faecal and serum samples

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: DNA extraction from aliquots of faecal samples was performed using NucleoSpin soil mini kit (MACHEREY‑NAGEL)

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: Purified and amplified DNA fragment libraries were sequenced using the Ion Proton Sequencer

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

antibiotics_exclusion_period_unit.evidence_quote: antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months

sex.evidence_quote: we decided to include only women in the present study

ancestry.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women with AN cases

ancestry_details.evidence_quote: we only included Danish Caucasian women

location.evidence_quote: recruited from three specialized centres in Denmark from 1 September 2014 to 31 July 2016. The centres were: Center for Eating Disorders (Odense University Hospital), Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Unit (Aarhus University Hospital) and Unit for Psychiatric Research (Aalborg University Hospital)

westernized.notes: Inferred from Danish/Caucasian ancestry; may reflect westernized lifestyle though not explicitly stated

age_min.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr
age_min.notes: FMT donor ages were 20, 22, and 20 years for AN cases; HC donors were 20, 22, and 21 years.

age_max.evidence_quote: three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2
age_max.notes: FMT donor ages; main human cohort ages not specifically stated for all groups.

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: Exclusion criteria comprised antibiotic or antifungal treatment within the previous 3 months
antibiotics_current_use.notes: AN and HC participants were excluded if treated with antibiotics within 3 months prior to enrollment.

bmi.evidence_quote: three patients with AN (females aged 20, 22 and 20 yr with BMI of 10.3, 11.5 and 11.7 kg m −2, respectively) and three HC
bmi.notes: FMT donor BMI values: AN donors 10.3, 11.5, 11.7 kg/m²; HC donors 22.6, 21.1, 21.2 kg/m². Mean for AN≈11.5, for HC≈21.6.

disease.evidence_quote: 77 female AN cases and 70 age-matched female controls considered to be of healthy weight (HC)
disease.section: Results — Phenotypes of women with AN and controls
disease.notes: Study comprised AN patients (including restricting and binge-purging subtypes) and healthy controls.

disease_details.evidence_quote: It can be classified into two subtypes, the common restricting (AN-RS) type and the less prevalent binge-eating or purging (AN-BP) type
disease_details.notes: AN classified into restricting and binge-purging subtypes per DSM-5.

obgyn_birth_control.evidence_quote: regular medication of any kind apart from birth control pills, and antibiotics within the last 3 months
obgyn_birth_control.notes: Birth control pills were permitted in healthy control participants, implying some participants used them.

smoker.evidence_quote: covariates including age, BMI, smoking and multiple drug intake were corrected
smoker.notes: Smoking was recorded as a covariate in analyses but no specific prevalence or status details provided for participants.

treatment.evidence_quote: multiple medications (selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines... all out-patients were also enrolled in cognitive behavioural therapeutic treatment
treatment.notes: AN inpatients and outpatients received multidisciplinary treatment including medication and CBT as described in treatment protocols.

zigosity.notes: Twin zygosity data not collected in this study; twin studies cited in discussion but no zygosity assignment for study participants.

age_years.notes: Main cohort age not reported as single mean value; only age range for FMT donors provided (20–22 years AN, 20–22 years HC).

dietary_restriction.notes: No explicit dietary restriction categories reported; study acknowledges lack of diet data as a limitation.

feces_phenotype.notes: Stool phenotype/appearance not recorded; only microbiota and metabolomics composition analyzed.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: anorexia-transplanted (AN-T) and the normal control-transplanted (HC-T) mice were weighed
fmt_id.notes: FMT recipient mice identified as AN-T (transplanted with AN donor stool) and HC-T (transplanted with HC donor stool).

fmt_role.evidence_quote: Faecal samples from randomly selected subsets of three patients with AN... and three HC... were used to colonize 6-week-old female GF littermates
fmt_role.notes: Human AN and HC participants were FMT donors; germ-free mice were recipients following fecal transplantation procedure.

hla.notes: HLA typing information not collected or reported in study.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Birth weight data not collected for study participants.

neonatal_delivery_procedure.notes: Delivery method not recorded in study.

neonatal_feeding_method.notes: Infant feeding method(s) not reported for study participants.

neonatal_gestational_age.notes: Gestational age at birth not collected.

obgyn_menopause.notes: Menopausal status not explicitly reported; study population included females aged 20–22 years in FMT subset, suggesting premenopausal status.

obgyn_pregnancy.notes: Pregnancy status not explicitly reported for study participants.
